decisions.reason: Because the net price display plugin received only limited visible support and disappeared from the website quickly, management would see too little public commitment or strategic centrality to justify continued escalation despite the sunk development effort.

Because the ERP system interface plugin builds directly on the firm's core shop-services offer, supports its multichannel direction, and was given its own page, management would be inclined to continue backing it and attribute any weaker results to temporary commercialization issues.
